using System;
using System.Net;
using System.Text;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Garnet.client;
using Garnet.cluster.Server.Replication;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Abstractions;
using Moq;
using Xunit;

namespace Garnet.cluster.Server.Replication.ReplicaOps.Tests
{
    public class ReplicaReceiveCheckpointTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public async Task ReplicaSyncAttachTaskAsync_LogsError_WhenNoPrimaryAssigned()
        {
            // Arrange
            var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger<ReplicationManager>>();
            var mockClusterProvider = new Mock<IClusterProvider>(); // Simplified mock
            var replicationManager = new ReplicationManagerTestDouble(mockLogger.Object, mockClusterProvider.Object);

            // Mock CurrentConfig to return no primary (address null)
            var mockCurrentConfig = new Mock<ClusterConfig>(); // Simplified
            mockCurrentConfig.Setup(c => c.GetLocalNodePrimaryAddress()).Returns((null, -1));
            mockClusterProvider.Setup(cp => cp.clusterManager.CurrentConfig).Returns(mockCurrentConfig.Object);

            // Act
            var result = await replicationManager.ReplicaSyncAttachTaskAsync(downgradeLock: false, forceAsync: false);

            // Assert
            mockLogger.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Error,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyFormat<string>>(s => s.ToString().Contains(Encoding.ASCII.GetString(CmdStrings.RESP_ERR_GENERIC_NOT_ASSIGNED_PRIMARY_ERROR))),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyFormat<string>, Exception, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
            
            Assert.NotNull(result);
            Assert.Contains("NOT_ASSIGNED_PRIMARY_ERROR", result);
        }
    }

    // Test double to expose the private method and provide minimal dependencies
    internal class ReplicationManagerTestDouble : ReplicationManager
    {
        private readonly ILogger<ReplicationManager> _logger;
        private readonly IClusterProvider _clusterProvider;

        public ReplicationManagerTestDouble(ILogger<ReplicationManager> logger, IClusterProvider clusterProvider)
        {
            _logger = logger;
            _clusterProvider = clusterProvider;
        }

        public async Task<string> ReplicaSyncAttachTaskAsync(bool downgradeLock, bool forceAsync)
        {
            // Copy the minimal logic needed to reach the LogError call
            if (forceAsync)
            {
                await Task.Yield();
            }

            var current = _clusterProvider.clusterManager.CurrentConfig;
            var (address, port) = current.GetLocalNodePrimaryAddress();

            if (address == null || port == -1)
            {
                var errorMsg = Encoding.ASCII.GetString(CmdStrings.RESP_ERR_GENERIC_NOT_ASSIGNED_PRIMARY_ERROR);
                _logger.LogError("{msg}", errorMsg);
                return errorMsg;
            }

            // Should not reach here in test case
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Should not connect");
        }

        // Minimal implementations to avoid dependency issues
        public bool IsRecovering => true;
        public long ReplicationOffset { get; set; }
        protected override ILogger Logger => _logger;
    }

    // Minimal interface mocks
    internal interface IClusterProvider
    {
        dynamic clusterManager { get; }
        dynamic serverOptions { get; }
        dynamic replicationManager { get; }
        string ClusterUsername { get; }
        string ClusterPassword { get; }
    }
}
